# Copilot instructions

## Project shape

This is a Flutter application. `lib/main.dart` is the app entry point; app startup is intended to initialize Firebase before calling `runApp`. Firebase platform settings are centralized in the FlutterFire-generated `lib/firebase_options.dart`, selected through `DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform`. Linux is explicitly unsupported by those options.

The project currently has a single app source file and a single widget test. There is no established feature, state-management, or navigation architecture to extend yet. `test/widget_test.dart` uses `flutter_test` and imports the app through the `project_518` package.

## Project-specific conventions

- Keep Firebase configuration changes consistent across `lib/firebase_options.dart`, `firebase.json`, and the relevant native platform configuration. Treat `lib/firebase_options.dart` as generated by FlutterFire CLI rather than hand-maintaining generated values.
- Widget tests should exercise widgets directly with `WidgetTester`; the existing smoke-test pattern pumps the app widget and verifies visible UI behavior.
- `analysis_options.yaml` includes `flutter_lints/flutter.yaml` and excludes generated platform directories from analysis.

## Commands

Run these from the repository root with Flutter and Dart available on `PATH`:

```sh
flutter pub get
flutter analyze
dart format lib test
flutter test
flutter test test/widget_test.dart
flutter test test/widget_test.dart --plain-name "Counter increments smoke test"
flutter build apk
flutter build web
```

Use `flutter build <target>` for other configured Flutter targets. Firebase options currently do not support Linux.
